entries.note: Zhou 2009 = PMID 19223643, epub 2009-02-17; quote verbatim in abstract. Opener OK. Caveat: the cell model and its first patient result were public in Idenix's Feb/Sep 2008 releases (tier 5), so model_first_use_year 2009 rests on rule question 1.

Zala 2012 = PMID 22314532, epub 2012-02-06; quote verbatim (abstract). Viral load is the proximal readout the brief names; direction matched, so same. NCT00945282 results posted 2018-11-29 confirmed. Same trial was reported in Idenix's Sep 2008 release (rule question 1).

Four-fold-over-adjusted-IC90 sentence verbatim in Zhou 2009 abstract. Target reached in healthy volunteers before efficacy was known is untested under the dose table. No NOAEL/MTD in any source read, so margin_stated false holds.

Emax/Ctau sentence verbatim in Zala 2012 abstract; 0.97 vs 1.8 log10 at 30 vs 100-800 mg supports reached-and-enough. The 0.6-fold figure for 30 mg is the drafter's arithmetic, not checkable from abstracts. Anderson 2015 'C24 h>19 nM' verbatim.

Opener identical to engagement opener; cell culture alone is the efficacy basis in the Pifeltro label 12.4 (bundle 210806 txt lines 722-740). No humanized-mouse or RT-SHIV study of any member found by search, so one track is right.

Quote verbatim. NCT00945282 lists day-8 HIV-1 RNA change among its primary outcomes, so endpoint_role primary holds. All five patient_trials quotes and registry dates verified (2018-11-29, 2019-02-15, 2018-10-23, 2018-04-30, 2017-10-12). PubMed has no elsulfavirine patient trial.

Quote verbatim (healthy-volunteer outcome, as the draft says). Proxy opener acceptable. Doravirine tox species beyond the label (rat, rabbit, mouse) unverifiable: Drugs@FDA posts no review for NDA 210806/210807 (TOC and MultidisciplineR all 404).

Castellino 2013 = PMID 23227887, epub 2012-12-20; quote verbatim. 'Unexpectedly' plus Margolis 2014 'without precedent' (verbatim, epub 2013-10-24) support silence-contradicted contra; seizures are a harm rodent/dog/monkey can show. FDA clinical hold was in the press Feb 2011 (rule question 1).

Quote verbatim in abstract. Built after the seizures, so retro not same (decision 10) is right. Whether minipigs themselves seized is not verifiable: ACS full text paywalled and web search found nothing; partial on the metabolite match is the defensible call.

Khalilieh 2018 = PMID 29723418, epub 2018-05-03, tier 1; quote verbatim in abstract (full text paywalled). Projection with no twice-daily human data until 2020: untested, prospective. 2018 label DDI table carries only the single-dose row, consistent with model_filed.

Yee 2021 = PMID 32989795, epub 2020-09-28; quote verbatim in abstract. Prospective: trial 'subsequent' to model, 2018 projection and label preceded it; volunteer PK admissible for dose (decision 3). Observed BID row (N=15, AUC 1.03, C24 0.98) first in 01/2022 label, absent 10/2019, so 2020 stands; magnitude fillable from it.

missing: Patient-level use of the same cell-culture track has no entry: Pifeltro label section 12.4 (http://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2018/210806s000lbl.pdf, bundle txt lines 736-750) sets cell-culture-selected V106A/M, F227C, Y318F beside the substitutions in DRIVE-FORWARD/DRIVE-AHEAD virologic failures (7 of 11 with >97-fold phenotypic resistance), tier 2, comparison stated, 2018; the draft notes it in a confidence_note but enters no prediction_level: patient entry.

Tier-5 patient-side sources the draft did not cite: Idenix press release, Sep 2008 (https://www.biospace.com/idenix-pharmaceuticals-inc-announces-completion-of-proof-of-concept-study-for-idx899-in-treatment-naive-hiv-infected-patients) reporting 1.78/1.78/1.84/1.87 log10 at 800/400/200/100 mg after 7 days, i.e. the Zala 2012 comparison four years earlier; and Feb 2011 press coverage of the FDA clinical hold after four seizure reports (https://newprod1.poz.com/article/hiv-gsk761-idenix-19885-4233), 22 months before Castellino. Status unchanged by either; dates depend on rule question 1.

No separate model system found: WebSearch for doravirine/elsulfavirine/VM-1500 in humanized mice or RT-SHIV macaques returned only generic model papers, and PubMed (elsulfavirine OR VM-1500 OR fosdevirine OR GSK2248761 OR IDX899) has no animal-efficacy or elsulfavirine patient-trial paper. Elsulfavirine's only regulator record is a 2017 Russian MoH registration, outside the tier-2 list (rule question 4).

Tier-2 observed record of the dor-cyp3a-induction-pk-model confirmatory trial, not cited by the dose index-4 entry: Pifeltro label s007 (01/2022, https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2022/210806s007lbl.pdf) Table 9, rifabutin 300 mg QD with doravirine 100 mg BID, N=15, AUC 1.03 (0.94-1.14), Cmax 0.97 (0.87-1.08), C24 0.98 (0.88-1.10); footnote 'Doravirine 100 mg BID resulted in similar pharmacokinetic values when compared to 100 mg QD without rifabutin'. Absent from the 10/2019 s003 label. Supplies the magnitude (observed C24 ratio 0.98 vs projected restoration to the QD trough) and subjects the entry leaves null; year unchanged. Candidate in-silico dose model with no track: population-PK dose bridge for adolescents 35-<45 kg, Pifeltro label 12.3 (s007 01/2022; current 07/2026 revision: 'the population pharmacokinetic model-predicted mean C24 of doravirine was comparable to that achieved in adults, whereas mean AUC0-24 and Cmax were 25% and 36% higher', IMPAACT 2014 n=54). A post-hoc exposure bridge built on the observed pediatric data, so it would score dose untested with source_calls_it: scaling (decision 4) rather than same; listed for the drafter to decide, not a missed comparison. rule_questions: Does a tier-5 sponsor press release set `year` (and `model_first_use_year`) for a comparison whose status is set by a later tier-1 paper? Rule 6 lists registry posting, online publication, label or print only. Here Idenix's Sep 2008 release reported the fosdevirine 7-day monotherapy result four years before Zala 2012, and the seizure clinical hold was public Feb 2011 vs Castellino Dec 2012; if yes, engagement/dose/efficacy `same` move to 2008 and safety `contra` to 2011, closing the 2009-2012 gap the strip draws.

`model_kind` has no in-vitro value: a cell-culture replication assay with laboratory HIV-1 strains in MT-4/MT4-GFP cells is not ex_vivo (patient cells). Which value should antiviral cell-culture models carry, or should the enum gain `in_vitro`?

When the engagement readout (viral load, proximal) is also the trial's primary endpoint, do engagement and efficacy both score `same` from the same 7-day monotherapy study, or should efficacy wait for a treatment trial with a clinical virologic endpoint (<50 copies/mL at week 48)?
Is a registration by a regulator outside the tier-2 list (elsulfavirine, Russian Ministry of Health, 2017) a tier-2 source, or inadmissible so the member stays without a tier 1-3 patient source?

dor-cyp3a-induction-pk-model joins two in-silico methods under one model_id: nonparametric superposition (Khalilieh 2018, predicts doravirine trough) and a PBPK model (Yee 2021, predicts M9) built later for the same dose adjustment; the 2022 label row tests only the superposition projection, the PBPK's M9 prediction is tested only in the Yee abstract. Decision 8 does not say whether successive in-silico methods for one dosing question are one system or two tracks. [CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 / models]
